instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: You are working with .js / .jsx files, NOT TypeScript. Do not create .tsx files.
1. Ensure the UI is entirely built for a premium dark mode, utilizing #050505 as base and #8B5CF6 strategically.
2. DO NOT use generic fonts (Inter, Roboto). Strictly use 'Clash Display' for headings and 'Outfit' for body. Import them via Google Fonts.
3. Ensure the Hero section includes the tagline 'YOUR VISION, OUR CODE' prominently, paired with the hero background asset.
4. Use a Bento Grid pattern (Mode A 'Tetris') for the Services section. Avoid 100% symmetric standard 3-column cards.
5. Use `data-testid` on ALL interactive components (buttons, links, form inputs) based on their role.
6. Build a complete working contact form at the bottom, capturing leads and storing them into MongoDB.
7. Implement a Tech Stack Marquee with react-fast-marquee showing tools relevant to modern SaaS dev.
8. Use the provided brand logo SVG in the fixed navigation header.
9. Rely on generous padding (p-12, py-32) and optical alignment to create a breathable, high-end design.
